Mahjong.//WebBaseUrl: Fallback used to build invite links. The web app rebuilds them from the address it was actually opened on, so this only matters for links generated server-side.
Mahjong.//Rules: House rules a new table starts with, when the create-room request does not carry its own. Every switch here is a real disagreement between published Filipino rule sets, listed in RULES.md section 7. Anything left out falls back to the compiled default in Rules.cs. appsettings.Development.json overrides this file key by key.

Rules.//JokerEnabled: Pick a random playable face each hand whose four copies are wild.
Rules.//JokerCanCompleteClaimedWin: Whether a joker may stand in for the tile claimed off a discard to win.
Rules.//SieteParesEnabled: Whether the seven-pairs-plus-one-set shape is a legal win.
Rules.//DistinctPairsForSietePares: Whether the seven pairs must be seven different faces.
Rules.//ChowFromLeftOnly: Whether a chow may only be claimed from the player immediately before you.
Rules.//TodasBeatsPungAndKang: Whether a todas declaration outranks a pung or kang on the same discard.
Rules.//ClaimWindowSeconds: How long other players get to claim a discard (pung, kang, chow, todas) before play moves on.
Rules.//ManoKeepsSeatOnDraw: Whether the mano keeps the deal when a hand ends with no winner.
Rules.//QuickWinDiscardLimit: Discards after which a win no longer counts as a quick win.

Scoring.//TodasBase: What a plain todas pays before any bonus, in abstract units.
Scoring.//BunotDoubles: Self-drawn win doubles the whole total and every player pays it.
Scoring.//DiscarderMultiplier: How much more the player who fed the winning tile pays than the other two.
Scoring.//Ambitions: Units each mid-hand bonus pays, charged to each of the three other players.
Scoring.//Bonuses: Units each win bonus adds to the total.
